      "notes": "Lite review batch 0058 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/chats/gates-of-morning-main.lua",
      "source": "I am back from the Charred Scar, where the orcs took the staff.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "我从灼烧之痕回来了，兽人把法杖带到了那里。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "36d60cd969902fbfde90a8a53a0f9a0a83517cf85f8d9fd58b001b41295c5919",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0058 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/chats/gates-of-morning-main.lua",
      "source": "The news has indeed reached me. I could scarce believe it, so long have we been at war with the Pride.\nNow they are dead? At the hands of just one @playerdescriptor.race@? Truly I am amazed by your power.\nWhile you were busy bringing an end to the orcs, we managed to discover some parts of the truth from a captive orc.\nHe talked about the shield protecting the High Peak. It seems to be controlled by \"orbs of command\" which the masters of the Prides had in their possession.\nHe also said the only way to enter the peak and de-activate the shield is through the \"slime tunnels\", located somewhere in one of the Prides, probably Grushnak.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "我的确已经得到了消息，真令人难以置信，我们和兽人已经战斗得太久了。\n他们现在都死了么？仅凭一个 @playerdescriptor.race@ 的力量？你的力量真让我惊叹。\n当你忙于解决那些兽人的时候，我们设法从那个兽人俘虏那里获得了一些线索。\n他提起了有关巅峰保护罩的事。似乎那个护罩是受“指令水晶球”操控的，那些指令水晶球就在兽人各大部落首领的手中。\n他还说想要进入巅峰并关闭护罩的唯一通道是“史莱姆通道”，位于某一个兽人部落内，有可能是格鲁希纳克的部落。\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "70290e36dfdcc582edb7ad85a941d9a66231cf8fe063cc32d38351c740327e93",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0058 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/chats/gates-of-morning-main.lua",
      "source": "I have already sent parties to clear out the remainder of the prides as you progressed, and have instructed to keep a sharp eye out for any orbs of command you may have missed.\n\tWhich do you not have? I can check with the parties if they found any. Our sources indicate that you should have four: one of Undeath, one of Destruction, one of Dragons, and one of Elemental might.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "我们已经派出部队，清理那些被你所击溃的部落的残军。我命令他们仔细搜查，留意任何你可能遗漏的指令水晶球。\n\t你缺少了什么水晶球？我会去问问他们，看看他们有没有找到。根据我们得到的情报，你应该有四颗指令水晶球：亡灵水晶球，毁灭水晶球，巨龙水晶球，元素水晶球。"
    }
  ],
